title: StockEdge100 Stage 3 Attempt 2 development admissibility evidence

window.declared_bounds_source: governance/STAGE_1_HOLDOUT_LOCK.json, sha256 9696161c4c5612fc7f6b3e5a3410917f20ad5707cb9b89b8bcc39cb70831dfb3. Boundary dates are read from that file and are deliberately not restated here.

permitted: development window only, bounds read from governance/STAGE_1_HOLDOUT_LOCK.json
prohibited: validation window - LOCKED, no observation read, no metric computed, no boundary moved
holdout window - SEALED, no observation read; only previously permitted integrity metadata may be inspected
any symbol outside the frozen universe, including AAPL
partitions.enforcement: stockedge100.backtest.window.ResearchWindow raises WindowViolation on any session outside the development window, and MarketView raises LookAheadError on any read past the decision session. Both are structural; neither depends on a candidate behaving well. Attempt 2 adds no code path that could bypass them.
partitions.boundary_changes: None. Attempt 2 does not move, widen, narrow, or re-cut any partition boundary.

window.note: Every run below is bounded by the Stage 1 holdout lock. ResearchWindow.check rejects a run start or a run end outside the development window, and MarketView raises LookAheadError on any read past the decision session, so no validation observation and no holdout observation enters a market view, a decision, a metric, or any number reported here. That is the mechanism the sealed partitions.enforcement names, and it is the Gate 2 validated one. It is a statement about what reached a computation: the normalized per-symbol CSVs are opened in full at load time, as they were at Gate 2 and at Attempt 1's Gate 3, so it is not a claim that no later-dated row was ever read off disk.

stressed.note: Applied to the three non-gating stressed-cost runs only. The stress scales trading friction; it leaves min_order_notional_usd and research_shutdown_drawdown at their base values, so RA1-2's size floor and the section 5.1 shutdown are the same in both scenarios.

iteration_budget.runs_per_candidate: one primary run plus four robustness-neighbour runs, plus one non-gating stressed-cost run of the primary
iteration_budget.meaning: Each candidate is run once at its primary parameterisation. No parameter is changed, no rule is amended, no symbol is added or removed, and no candidate is re-run after any result is seen. A candidate that fails is reported as failed. Constitution section 11: a change to universe, timing, cost, signal, parameter range, metric, threshold, or data partition is material, and a material change creates a NEW candidate that restarts at Gate 3 - it does not repair this one.
iteration_budget.neighbour_runs_are_not_iterations: The four neighbour runs per candidate exist solely to evaluate S3-C7 on the sign of net return. They are never used to select a parameterisation, are never promoted to primary, and their metrics other than the sign of net return are reported but carry no gate weight.
iteration_budget.stress_runs_are_not_iterations: The three stressed-cost runs are diagnostics required by constitution section 7. They are non-gating at Gate 3 and cannot admit or reject any candidate. See cost_stress_treatment.

known_prior_evidence.source: Already-exposed Attempt 1 evidence: governance/STAGE_3_PREREGISTRATION.md, governance/STAGE_3_STRATEGY_RESEARCH_REPORT.md, reports/stage3/, runs/SE100-R-20260810T101622Z.json. No new performance result was generated, loaded, or computed to write this file.
known_prior_evidence.attempt_1_headline_fact: All six candidates produced positive after-cost total return and all six passed neighbour sign stability, and all six breached the 15% maximum-drawdown ceiling of S3-C2. Three additionally missed the 30-closed-trade floor of S3-C4, two failed the profit-concentration condition S3-C6, and one failed the best-trade-removal condition S3-C5.

attempt_1_closed_trade_counts.use_in_this_file: These counts are used for one purpose only: to exclude, prospectively, families whose specification form cannot plausibly reach the unchanged 30-closed-trade floor. Trade frequency is a structural property of a specification, not a profitability result. The use is an adaptation and is disclosed as one in adaptive_research_disclosure.
attempt_1_closed_trade_counts.not_used_for: No parameter, threshold, lookback, exposure fraction, loss limit, or holding period in this file was selected by reference to any Attempt 1 return, drawdown path, equity curve, profit factor, or trade-level outcome.

known_prior_evidence.attempt_1_most_useful_finding_quoted: STAGE_3_STRATEGY_RESEARCH_REPORT.md: 'The observation in section 7 - that the risk control and the quality gate are the same number, so any candidate volatile enough to trip one has failed the other - is the most useful thing this stage produced, and it belongs to whoever writes the next pre-registration.'
known_prior_evidence.design_target_derived_from_it: S3-C2 is satisfied if and only if the constitution section 5.1 research shutdown never fires, because both are 15% below the running high-water mark of the same session-close equity series and the sealed action is LIQUIDATE_AT_NEXT_OPEN_AND_BLOCK_ENTRIES. Attempt 2 therefore treats never tripping the shutdown as the design target rather than as a side effect.

items: Attempt 1's results are known to the researcher who wrote this file. This is an adaptive second attempt at Gate 3, not an independent first look.
All six Attempt 1 candidates breached the 15% maximum-drawdown ceiling. Some also failed the closed-trade-count floor, the profit-concentration condition, and the best-trade-removal condition.

The development data are no longer pristine with respect to at least the broad fact that the first candidate set produced excessive drawdown, and with respect to the per-candidate closed-trade counts recorded above. Attempt 2's design is conditioned on those facts.
Researcher degrees of freedom are higher in Attempt 2 than in Attempt 1, and false-discovery risk is correspondingly higher, because the design space was narrowed using an observed outcome.
The total experiment count for any later statistical interpretation is the cumulative count across both attempts, not Attempt 2's count alone. See cumulative_experiment_count.

No Attempt 2 result may be described as independent confirmation of anything merely because the code that produced it is new. The candidates share development data, a researcher, and a known prior outcome with Attempt 1.

Three of the three Attempt 2 candidates hold the entry and exit signal in the same rule FORM as a rejected Attempt 1 candidate. That is deliberate - the research question is about risk structure, so the return source is held fixed and the risk architecture is varied - and it means Attempt 2 is a second look at the same signals on the same data, not a new hypothesis about what predicts returns.
Validation-window and holdout-window protections are unchanged by this attempt. The validation window remains LOCKED and the holdout window remains SEALED.
A passing development result authorises only the next frozen evaluation step. It is not evidence of a trading edge, and it is not a claim about any future period.

This adaptation is not concealed behind a new strategy identifier. Each candidate id carries the RA1 suffix naming the shared risk architecture, and each candidate block states in distinction_from_attempt_1 exactly which rejected Attempt 1 candidate it shares its signal form with.

adaptive_research.multiple_comparisons_disclosure: Three candidates are tested against the same development data that six candidates were already tested against, by a researcher who knows how those six failed. A per-candidate criterion is not a family-wise one, and the probability that at least one of nine specifications passes by chance exceeds the probability that any single pre-specified one does. Because the Attempt 2 design space was narrowed by an observed Attempt 1 outcome, the effective search is wider than nine independent draws and cannot be bounded by counting runs. Nothing in this attempt corrects for it numerically. The correction the constitution relies on is that an admitted candidate must still survive Gate 4 robustness, Gate 5's single sealed holdout read, and the duration-based paper and shadow gates. Attempt 2 weakens none of those and earns no relief from any of them.

cumulative_experiment_count.binding_number_for_interpretation: 9 candidates and 45 gating variants against the same development window. Any later statistical statement about Gate 3 evidence uses the cumulative figure, not Attempt 2's figure.
cumulative_experiment_count.distinct_signal_forms: Attempt 2 introduces no new signal form. Its three signals share rule form with three of Attempt 1's six candidates, so the cumulative count of distinct signal forms tested at Gate 3 remains 6, while the cumulative count of distinct SPECIFICATIONS tested is 9.

determinism.condition: each primary reproduces its own trades and equity digests on a re-run
determinism.note: Each primary is executed a second time under a distinct #RERUN label and only its trade and equity digests are compared. Sealed rerun_policy: 'a re-run of an unchanged variant must reproduce byte-identical output. A re-run that produced a DIFFERENT number would be a determinism defect and a blocker, not a better result.' The reported result is the first execution's in every field, and the re-run is not one of the 18 declared runs.
determinism.declared: Every rule in this file is deterministic given the sealed dataset, the sealed cost model, and the sealed calendar. Two runs of the same variant must produce byte-identical equity curves, trade logs, and metrics.
determinism.random_seeds_note: There are none to declare. The field is present and null rather than absent, so that its absence cannot later be read as an omission.

stressed_cost_run.declared_rule: Each candidate's PRIMARY parameterisation is additionally run at 2x the complete base trading-friction assumption, over the same window, with the research shutdown enforced. Three such runs in total.
stressed_cost_run.prohibition: The STRESS_FRAGILE flag may not be used at Gate 3 to admit a candidate that failed a hard condition, nor to reject a candidate that satisfied all of them.
stressed_cost_run.flag_semantics: STRESS_FRAGILE is raised when the stressed run's total return is not strictly positive. It is recorded, never gating: the sealed prohibition is that it 'may not be used at Gate 3 to admit a candidate that failed a hard condition, nor to reject a candidate that satisfied all of them'.

conditions.required_verbatim: total return is positive
maximum drawdown is no worse than 15%
profit factor is at least 1.10
at least 30 closed trades exist, unless a lower-frequency protocol predeclared a longer evidence requirement before results
conditions.note: No candidate in this stage invokes the lower-frequency exception. The exception permits a LONGER evidence requirement, not a smaller trade count, so it could not lower this floor in any case. Recorded explicitly so that a low-frequency candidate cannot later be argued into the exception after its trade count is known.

conditions.required_verbatim: performance is not dependent on one trade: removing the single best trade leaves total return above 0%
conditions.note: The realized total return reconstructed from closed trades can differ slightly from the equity-curve total return when a position is open on the final session or when dividends are credited outside a trade. Both figures are reported; the condition is evaluated on the reconstruction, whose whole purpose is to be a like-for-like comparison against the same reconstruction with one trade removed.

conditions.required_verbatim: no single instrument contributes more than 50% of total strategy profit for a multi-instrument strategy
conditions.note: The condition's own words are 'for a multi-instrument strategy'. A universal reading would make a single-instrument candidate contribute 100% of its own profit and fail automatically, which would render four of the six strategy families the constitution names in section 3 — trend/momentum, pullback, mean reversion, breakout — untestable at Gate 3. That cannot be the intent of a clause whose stated purpose is to detect concentration across instruments. The interpretation and its rationale are fixed here, before any result, and are surfaced in the stage report rather than buried.

evidence.treatment: NOT_APPLICABLE_BY_CONDITION_TEXT, with the declared instrument count recorded as the evidence.

conditions.required_verbatim: reasonable neighboring parameter values do not reverse the sign of net return
conditions.threshold: all four match, zero matches nothing
conditions.note: Neighbour runs are evaluated for the sign of net return and nothing else. No neighbour is ever promoted to primary, and no primary parameterisation is revised because a neighbour did better. Doing so would be a material change under constitution section 11 and would create a new candidate restarting at Gate 3.

benchmarks.note: Constitution section 4: 'Beating SPY is not mandatory if a strategy materially reduces drawdown, but passing requires positive after-cost performance and better risk-adjusted performance than cash.' This is the clause under which Attempt 2's thesis is constitutionally coherent: a structurally lower-risk strategy is permitted to earn less than SPY. Neither benchmark is a Gate 3 hard condition; both are reported for every candidate and every neighbour so that a later gate reads them from evidence rather than re-deriving them.

spy_total_return.declared: SPY total return over each candidate's own run window, computed by the Gate 2 validated benchmark calculation. The opportunity-cost benchmark.

spy_tradable_buy_and_hold.declared: A SPY buy-and-hold account under the same base cost model over each candidate's own run window, reported both with the research shutdown enforced and with it disabled and explicitly labelled a benchmark reference account, exactly as Stage 2 and Attempt 1 reported it.

cash.declared: 0.00% annual. Constitution section 4 permits a 3-month Treasury-bill proxy where reliable point-in-time data exist, otherwise 0% explicitly labelled conservative. No T-bill series was acquired in Stage 1, so 0% is used. It makes the cash hurdle easier to beat, which is generous to a strategy and conservative for judging cash; the direction is recorded.
cash.note: 0% conservative proxy: no T-bill series was acquired in Stage 1. This makes the cash hurdle easier to beat, so it is conservative for judging cash and generous for judging a strategy.

do_nothing.declared: Flat equity at USD 100.00, zero trades.
do_nothing.note: Flat equity at starting capital, zero trades, zero costs.

candidates.primary_trade_ledger_note: The full closed-trade list for the primary run only, so S3-C3, S3-C5 and S3-C6 can be recomputed by hand from this file. Neighbour ledgers are omitted: only the sign of a neighbour's net return carries gate weight. The stressed run's ledger is omitted for the same reason in reverse — it carries no gate weight at all.

warning.rule: A per-condition rollup row aggregates SATISFACTION across candidates and therefore means only 'at least one candidate satisfied this condition'. It is not evidence that any candidate satisfied all of them, and it settles nothing on its own.
warning.required_reporting_shape: Each per-condition row must carry three separate lists - met_by, not_met_by, and not_applicable_for - so that a NOT_APPLICABLE_BY_CONDITION_TEXT verdict is visible as such rather than folded into a pass or a fail.
warning.known_failure_mode_recorded: Aggregating a per-condition row on verdict == MET rather than on satisfaction produced a false FAIL for S3-C6 in Attempt 1's first rollup. The rollup must aggregate on satisfaction. It is recorded here so the same defect is not reintroduced by a fresh implementation.
warning.decisive_row: The conditions table must carry the admissible_candidate_exists row, and that row alone decides the gate. A conditions table that omits it is misleading and is not an acceptable deliverable.

decisive_row.frozen_rule: admissible_candidate_exists is TRUE if and only if there exists at least one pre-registered Attempt 2 candidate for which EVERY applicable Gate 3 hard condition is SATISFIED, where satisfied means the condition's verdict is MET or NOT_APPLICABLE_BY_CONDITION_TEXT.
decisive_row.within_candidate: CONJUNCTIVE. All seven conditions are evaluated for every candidate; all applicable ones must be satisfied by that same candidate.
decisive_row.across_candidates: DISJUNCTIVE. One admissible candidate is enough to pass Gate 3.
decisive_row.gate_verdict_condition: At least one pre-registered candidate satisfies EVERY hard condition of Gate 3.

stage_verdict.condition_token: At least one pre-registered candidate satisfies EVERY hard condition of Gate 3.
stage_verdict.combination_rule: Constitution section 9: gates are conjunctive; every hard condition must pass, and NOT_RUN, UNKNOWN, or missing evidence is not a pass. Conjunction applies WITHIN a candidate. Across candidates the stage verdict is a disjunction, because Gate 3 asks whether a candidate worth carrying forward exists, not whether every candidate tried is good.

explicit_non_authorizations: No data of any kind is downloaded, purchased, or acquired by this attempt. Every price comes from the Stage 1 normalized dataset already on disk.
No validation-window or holdout-window data is read. The window guard raises WindowViolation structurally rather than relying on discipline.

No frozen artifact is edited, regenerated, replaced, superseded, or re-encoded. Attempt 1's SE100-CFG-3001, SE100-CFG-3002, its pre-registration, its decision record, its manifest, its checksum records, and its run record are read-only and byte-for-byte unchanged.
No Attempt 1 candidate is re-run, re-parameterised, repaired, or combined with an Attempt 2 candidate.
No Gate 3 condition, threshold, denominator, predicate, boundary, undefined case, or not-evaluable treatment is changed. The 15% maximum-drawdown ceiling is unchanged.
No candidate is combined with any other candidate. Constitution section 8 prohibits combination until each component has an independent verdict, and no Attempt 2 component has one.
No machine learning, no optimiser, no search over any parameter grid, and no fit of any kind.
No fundamental, earnings, or intraday data is introduced. None exists in this project.
No paper order, no live order, no cancel, no replace, no liquidation, no broker call, and no unattended scheduling.
No Alpaca credential is read, and no credential presence is tested by this attempt.
No strategy is selected as a winner, and no expected income, profit, or return is claimed for any period, past or future.
no_selection_in_this_stage: Gate 3 is admissibility, not selection. Every candidate that satisfies every hard condition is recorded as admitted; the stage does not rank admitted candidates, does not name a winner, and does not carry a preference forward. Choosing which admitted candidate proceeds is a later-stage decision under the constitution's own rules.
evidence_digest_covers: every field of this file except generated_utc and evidence_digest, as canonical JSON
